steps.title: Sketch the block
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Rectangle (Two Point): start at the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 110 by 40. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the block
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 20 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Clearance hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face. Place the centre on the centre line of the top face, 15 from the left end.
Type: Simple Hole. Diameter 6.6 mm (clearance for M6). Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Counterbored hole (CBORE)
actions: Click Hole and click the top face. Place the centre on the centre line of the top face, 40 from the left end.
Type: Counterbore. Diameter 6.6 mm, counterbore diameter 11 mm, counterbore depth 6.5 mm. Through All. Click OK.
steps.note: A counterbore lets a cap head screw sit below the surface.

steps.title: Countersunk hole (CSK)
actions: Click Hole and click the top face. Place the centre on the centre line of the top face, 68 from the left end.
Type: Countersink. Diameter 6.6 mm, countersink diameter 13 mm, angle 90 degrees. Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Blind tapping drill hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face. Place the centre on the centre line of the top face, 95 from the left end.
Type: Simple Hole. Diameter 5 mm (tapping drill for M6). Termination: Distance, 15 mm. Drill Point: Flat. Click OK.
steps.note: For a real tapped hole choose Tapped Hole, M6x1, and Inventor adds the 5 mm drill and a cosmetic thread.
